results.title: Episode 57: Maya Collins on outbound experiments with a two-person team
results.content:
30 September 2026. Maya Collins, Head of Growth at Brightwave, on running outbound with a
small team. Maya Collins: "We test one new outbound angle a week, but writing research-backed
first emails by hand is the bottleneck. Two people can't personalise four hundred accounts."
